ex.en: Most scientific breakthroughs are nothing else than the discovery of the obvious.
ex.zh: 大多數科學突破，不過是發現了顯而易見的事。

ex.en: After many years of grueling training, she finally made a breakthrough and won the championship.
ex.zh: 經過多年艱苦訓練，她終於有所突破，奪得冠軍。

breakthrough.en: an important discovery or success after a long effort

ex.en: What's your favorite web browser?
ex.zh: 你最喜歡哪個瀏覽器？

ex.en: Not all internet browsers are safe.
ex.zh: 不是所有的網路瀏覽器都是安全的。

ex.en: The browser is running really slowly.
ex.zh: 瀏覽器跑得超慢。

browser.en: a computer program used to look at websites

ex.en: I left my briefcase in the bus.
ex.zh: 我把公事包忘在公車上了。

ex.en: My briefcase is full of papers.
ex.zh: 我的公事包裡塞滿了文件。

ex.en: He opened his briefcase and took out a contract.
ex.zh: 他打開公事包，拿出一份合約。

briefcase.en: a flat case for carrying papers and documents

ex.en: I hear you've already contacted the broker.
ex.zh: 聽說您已經跟仲介聯絡過了。

ex.en: My insurance broker found me a better plan.
ex.zh: 我的保險經紀人幫我找到更好的方案。

broker.en: a person who buys and sells things for other people

broker.zh: 促成（協議、交易）、居中協調

ex.en: Our firm brokered the deal between the two companies.
ex.zh: 我們公司促成了兩家公司之間的交易。

ex.en: She helped broker an agreement with the supplier.
ex.zh: 她幫忙促成了和供應商的協議。

broker.en: to arrange an agreement between two sides

ex.en: The brake stopped working.
ex.zh: 煞車失靈了。

ex.en: I'll only buy the car if they fix the brakes first.
ex.zh: 除非他們先把煞車修好，否則我不會買那輛車。

ex.en: Tom slammed on the brakes and the car began to skid.
ex.zh: 湯姆猛踩煞車，車子開始打滑。

brake.en: a part of a vehicle that makes it slow down or stop

ex.en: The driver braked suddenly to avoid the dog.
ex.zh: 司機為了閃避那隻狗突然煞車。

ex.en: Brake gently when the road is wet.
ex.zh: 路面濕滑時要輕踩煞車。

brake.en: to make a vehicle slow down or stop

ex.en: I can't find the broom.
ex.zh: 我找不到掃把。

ex.en: She brought a broom.
ex.zh: 她拿來了一支掃把。

broom.en: a brush with a long handle for cleaning the floor

ex.en: Traveling abroad can broaden your horizons.
ex.zh: 出國旅行可以開闊你的視野。

ex.en: The company plans to broaden its product range.
ex.zh: 公司計畫擴大產品線。

broaden.en: to make something wider or include more things

ex.en: Broadly speaking, the plan was a success.
ex.zh: 大致來說，這個計畫很成功。

ex.en: I broadly agree with your proposal.
ex.zh: 我大致上同意你的提案。

broadly.en: in a general way, without small details

ex.en: The term is used broadly in the industry.
ex.zh: 這個詞在業界被廣泛使用。

ex.en: The new rules apply broadly to all employees.
ex.zh: 新規定普遍適用於所有員工。

broadly.en: in a way that includes many things or people

ex.en: She smiled broadly when she heard the news.
ex.zh: 她聽到消息時笑得合不攏嘴。

ex.en: He grinned broadly at the camera.
ex.zh: 他對著鏡頭咧嘴大笑。

ex.en: She works at a brokerage firm.
ex.zh: 她在一家證券公司上班。

ex.en: Online brokerages charge lower fees.
ex.zh: 網路券商收費較低。

brokerage.en: a business that buys and sells things for other people

ex.en: The brokerage fee is two percent of the sale price.
ex.zh: 仲介費是售價的百分之二。

ex.en: We pay a small brokerage on each trade.
ex.zh: 我們每筆交易都要付一點手續費。

brokerage.en: money paid to an agent for arranging a sale

ex.en: Our car had a breakdown on the highway.
ex.zh: 我們的車在高速公路上拋錨了。

ex.en: A machine breakdown stopped production for two hours.
ex.zh: 機器故障讓生產停了兩小時。

breakdown.en: a time when a machine or vehicle stops working

ex.en: Can you give me a breakdown of the costs?
ex.zh: 可以給我一份費用明細嗎？

ex.en: The report includes a breakdown by region.
ex.zh: 這份報告附有各地區的細項。

breakdown.en: a list that shows the separate parts of a total

ex.en: There was a breakdown in communication between the teams.
ex.zh: 團隊之間的溝通出了問題。

ex.en: He had a nervous breakdown from stress.
ex.zh: 他因為壓力太大而精神崩潰。

breakdown.en: a failure of something, or a serious mental illness caused by stress

ex.en: The mayor denied having taken a bribe.
ex.zh: 市長否認收受賄賂。

ex.en: Police shouldn't take bribes.
ex.zh: 警察不應該收賄。

bribe.en: money given secretly to persuade someone to do something dishonest

ex.en: He tried to bribe the official.
ex.zh: 他試圖賄賂那名官員。

ex.en: They were accused of bribing the inspectors.
ex.zh: 他們被控賄賂檢查人員。

bribe.en: to give someone money to get them to do something dishonest

ex.en: Is broadband included in the rent?
ex.zh: 房租有包含寬頻網路嗎？

ex.en: The village still doesn't have broadband access.
ex.zh: 那個村莊至今還沒有寬頻網路。

ex.en: The old house is made of red brick.
ex.zh: 那棟老房子是紅磚蓋的。

ex.en: The workers are laying bricks.
ex.zh: 工人們正在砌磚。

brick.en: a hard block of baked clay used for building walls

ex.en: Put the phone number in brackets.
ex.zh: 把電話號碼放在括號裡。

ex.en: The old price is shown in brackets.
ex.zh: 原價標示在括號中。

bracket.en: one of two marks used to put extra words or numbers in writing

ex.en: He is in a higher tax bracket now.
ex.zh: 他現在屬於較高的稅率級距。

ex.en: This product targets the 25 to 35 age bracket.
ex.zh: 這個產品鎖定 25 到 35 歲的族群。

bracket.en: a group of people within certain limits of age or income

ex.en: We need a bracket to hang the shelf.
ex.zh: 我們需要一個托架來掛層板。

ex.en: The TV is mounted on a wall bracket.
ex.zh: 電視裝在壁掛架上。

bracket.en: a piece of metal or wood fixed to a wall to hold something up

ex.en: We know him to be a brave man.
ex.zh: 我們知道他是個勇敢的人。

ex.en: I think she is very brave.
ex.zh: 我覺得她很勇敢。

ex.en: I'm not as brave as Tom.
ex.zh: 我沒有湯姆那麼勇敢。

brave.en: ready to face danger or pain without showing fear

brave.zh: 冒著（惡劣天氣等）、勇敢面對

ex.en: We braved the rain to see the fireworks.
ex.zh: 我們冒雨去看煙火。

ex.en: Thousands of fans braved the cold to see the concert.
ex.zh: 數千名歌迷不畏寒冷去看演唱會。

brave.en: to face something unpleasant or dangerous without fear

brutal.zh: 殘酷的、嚴酷的；毫不留情的

ex.en: The competition in this industry is brutal.
ex.zh: 這個產業的競爭非常殘酷。

ex.en: The summer heat this year was brutal.
ex.zh: 今年夏天熱得要命。

ex.en: He gave me some brutal but honest feedback.
ex.zh: 他給了我一些毫不留情但很中肯的意見。

ex.en: What do you say to bringing your sister?
ex.zh: 帶你姊姊一起來怎麼樣？

ex.en: Please bring your ID card.
ex.zh: 請攜帶身分證。

bring.en: to take someone or something with you to a place

ex.en: What you did brought disgrace on the whole class.
ex.zh: 你的行為讓全班蒙羞。

ex.en: The new policy brought many changes.
ex.zh: 新政策帶來了許多改變。

bring.en: to cause something to happen or appear

ex.en: My wife's part-time job brings in a little extra money.
ex.zh: 我太太的兼職工作帶來一些額外收入。

ex.en: The new product brought in a lot of money.
ex.zh: 新產品賺進了很多錢。

ex.en: She brought up an interesting point.
ex.zh: 她提出了一個有趣的論點。

ex.en: Don't bring up that topic at dinner.
ex.zh: 吃晚餐時別提那個話題。

bring.en: to start talking about a subject

ex.en: I intend to visit Australia during my spring break.
ex.zh: 我打算春假時去澳洲玩。

ex.en: Let's take a ten-minute break.
ex.zh: 我們休息十分鐘吧。

break.en: a short rest from work, or a holiday from school

ex.en: I must apologize to you for breaking the vase.
ex.zh: 把你的花瓶打破了，真對不起。

ex.en: He got a broken jaw and lost some teeth.
ex.zh: 他的下巴骨折，還掉了幾顆牙。

break.en: to damage something so that it separates into pieces or stops working

ex.en: He must be fined if he breaks the law.
ex.zh: 如果他違法，就應該被罰款。

ex.en: You shouldn't break your promise.
ex.zh: 你不應該違背承諾。

break.en: to fail to obey a law or keep a promise

ex.en: The fire broke out after the staff went home.
ex.zh: 員工下班回家後發生了火災。

ex.en: A fire broke out in the warehouse.
ex.zh: 倉庫發生了火災。

break.en: to start suddenly, as a fire or war does

ex.en: My car broke down on the highway.
ex.zh: 我的車在高速公路上拋錨了。

ex.en: The printer broke down again.
ex.zh: 印表機又壞了。

break.en: to stop working, as a machine or vehicle does

ex.en: My brother is holding a camera in his hand.
ex.zh: 我弟弟手裡拿著一台相機。

ex.en: How many sisters do you have? How many brothers?
ex.zh: 你有幾個姊妹？幾個兄弟？

ex.en: I promised to help my brother with his homework.
ex.zh: 我答應幫弟弟做功課。

brother.en: a boy or man with the same parents as you

ex.en: Memory is an essential function of our brain.
ex.zh: 記憶是大腦的一項重要功能。

ex.en: As people get older, their brain cells become less efficient.
ex.zh: 隨著年紀增長，腦細胞的效率會變差。

ex.en: Reading is good exercise for your brain.
ex.zh: 閱讀是很好的大腦運動。

brain.en: the part inside the head that controls thinking and feeling

ex.en: That boy has good brains.
ex.zh: 那個男孩很聰明。

ex.en: She is the brains behind the project.
ex.zh: 她是這個專案的靈魂人物。

brain.en: the ability to think well, or a very clever person

ex.en: Could you give us a brief introduction of yourself?
ex.zh: 你能簡單介紹一下自己嗎？

ex.en: Let's take a brief look at this topic.
ex.zh: 我們來簡單看一下這個主題。

ex.en: We had a brief meeting this morning.
ex.zh: 我們今天早上開了一個簡短的會議。

brief.en: lasting only a short time or using few words

ex.en: The manager will brief us on the new project.
ex.zh: 經理會向我們簡報新專案。

ex.en: Please brief the team before the client arrives.
ex.zh: 請在客戶到之前先向團隊說明情況。

brief.en: to give someone the main facts about a situation

ex.en: He gave his reasons in brief.
ex.zh: 他簡要地說明了理由。

ex.en: In brief, the project was a success.
ex.zh: 簡單來說，這個專案很成功。

ex.en: Tom has very broad shoulders.
ex.zh: 湯姆的肩膀很寬。

ex.en: The river is very broad at this point.
ex.zh: 這條河在這一段非常寬。

broad.en: large from one side to the other

ex.en: Broad safety measures were put into effect.
ex.zh: 廣泛的安全措施已開始實施。

ex.en: We should judge matters on a broader basis.
ex.zh: 我們應該從更宏觀的角度來判斷事情。

ex.en: The store offers a broad range of products.
ex.zh: 這家店提供種類廣泛的商品。

broad.en: including many different things, without small details

broad.zh: in broad daylight：光天化日之下

ex.en: He had his car stolen in broad daylight.
ex.zh: 他的車在光天化日之下被偷了。

ex.en: Today, robbers robbed another bank in broad daylight.
ex.zh: 今天又有搶匪在光天化日之下搶了一家銀行。

broad.en: during the day when everyone can easily see

ex.en: A new branch will be opened in Chicago next month.
ex.zh: 下個月將在芝加哥開一家新分店。

ex.en: Our branches extend all over the country.
ex.zh: 我們的分店遍布全國。

branch.en: one of several offices or shops of a larger organization

ex.en: The lamp was suspended from the branch of a tree.
ex.zh: 燈籠掛在樹枝上。

ex.en: The willow branches swayed gently in the breeze.
ex.zh: 柳枝在微風中輕輕搖曳。

branch.en: a part of a tree that grows out from the trunk

ex.en: The company is branching out into online sales.
ex.zh: 公司正把業務拓展到網路銷售。

ex.en: The road branches off to the left.
ex.zh: 道路在左邊分岔。

branch.en: to divide into parts, or to start doing something new

ex.en: The lake was gleaming in the bright sunshine.
ex.zh: 湖水在燦爛的陽光下閃閃發亮。

ex.en: That tiny star there is the brightest out of all the stars.
ex.zh: 那顆小星星是所有星星裡最亮的。

bright.en: giving or filled with a lot of light

ex.en: I remember him as a cute, bright little boy.
ex.zh: 在我印象中，他是個可愛又聰明的小男孩。

ex.en: She's one of the brightest students in the class.
ex.zh: 她是班上最聰明的學生之一。

ex.en: The minute I have something to drink, I turn bright red.
ex.zh: 我一喝酒就會滿臉通紅。

ex.en: She was wearing a bright yellow dress.
ex.zh: 她穿著一件鮮黃色的洋裝。

bright.en: strong and easy to see, as a color

ex.en: The company has a bright future.
ex.zh: 這家公司前景光明。

ex.en: Try to look on the bright side.
ex.zh: 試著往好的方面想。

bright.en: likely to be good or successful

ex.en: I'll go with you as far as the bridge.
ex.zh: 我陪你走到橋那邊。

ex.en: I don't know the exact length of this bridge.
ex.zh: 我不知道這座橋確切有多長。

bridge.en: a structure that carries a road or path over a river or road

bridge.zh: 彌合、縮小（差距）（bridge the gap）

ex.en: The program helps bridge the gap between school and work.
ex.zh: 這個計畫幫助銜接學校與職場之間的落差。

ex.en: We need to bridge the gap between the two teams.
ex.zh: 我們需要縮小兩個團隊之間的隔閡。

bridge.en: to reduce or close the difference between two things

bridge.zh: cross that bridge when we come to it：到時候再說

ex.en: We'll cross that bridge when we come to it.
ex.zh: 船到橋頭自然直。

ex.en: Let's not worry about it yet; we'll cross that bridge when we come to it.
ex.zh: 先別擔心，到時候再說吧。

bridge.en: used to say you will deal with a problem only when it happens

ex.en: If you quit the job, you'll be burning your bridges.
ex.zh: 如果你辭掉這份工作，就等於自斷後路。

ex.en: Don't burn your bridges with your former employer.
ex.zh: 別跟前雇主把關係搞僵。

bridge.en: to do something that makes it impossible to go back

ex.en: She hid behind the door and held her breath.
ex.zh: 她躲在門後，屏住呼吸。

ex.en: Tom is still too out of breath to speak.
ex.zh: 湯姆還喘得說不出話來。

ex.en: Take a deep breath and relax.
ex.zh: 深呼吸，放輕鬆。

breath.en: the air that goes in and out of your body

ex.en: I am hungry because I did not eat breakfast.
ex.zh: 我沒吃早餐，所以肚子很餓。

ex.en: I'd like breakfast in my room at 8 sharp.
ex.zh: 我想在八點整於房間裡吃早餐。

ex.en: Many young people in Japan eat bread for breakfast.
ex.zh: 很多日本年輕人早餐吃麵包。

breakfast.en: the first meal of the day

ex.en: I'd like to have a test for breast cancer.
ex.zh: 我想做乳癌檢查。

ex.en: He doesn't drink enough breast milk.
ex.zh: 他喝的母乳不夠。

breast.en: one of the two soft parts on a woman's chest

ex.en: Tom eats rice every day either with fish or with chicken breast.
ex.zh: 湯姆每天吃飯不是配魚就是配雞胸肉。

ex.en: Grill the chicken breast for ten minutes.
ex.zh: 雞胸肉烤十分鐘。

breast.en: the meat from the front part of a bird

ex.en: Did you see a brown wallet around here?
ex.zh: 你有在這附近看到一個咖啡色的皮夾嗎？

ex.en: Who is the woman in the brown coat?
ex.zh: 那個穿棕色外套的女人是誰？

ex.en: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
ex.zh: 敏捷的棕色狐狸跳過了那隻懶狗。

brown.en: having the color of earth or chocolate

ex.en: The room was painted in shades of brown.
ex.zh: 這個房間漆成深淺不一的棕色。

ex.en: For shoes, she prefers brown to black.
ex.zh: 買鞋子時，她比較喜歡棕色而不是黑色。

brown.en: the color of earth or chocolate

ex.en: I want to breathe some fresh air.
ex.zh: 我想呼吸一下新鮮空氣。

ex.en: The air we breathe consists of oxygen and nitrogen.
ex.zh: 我們呼吸的空氣由氧氣和氮氣組成。

ex.en: Breathe deeply and try to relax.
ex.zh: 深呼吸，試著放鬆。

breathe.en: to take air into your body and let it out again

breathe.zh: breathe a sigh of relief：鬆一口氣

ex.en: We all breathed a big sigh of relief.
ex.zh: 我們都大大鬆了一口氣。

ex.en: Everyone breathed a sigh of relief when the project was finished.
ex.zh: 專案完成時，大家都鬆了一口氣。

breathe.en: to show that you feel better because a worry has gone

ex.en: What breed is your dog?
ex.zh: 你的狗是什麼品種？

ex.en: This breed of cattle produces high-quality milk.
ex.zh: 這個品種的牛能產出優質牛奶。

breed.en: a particular kind of animal within a larger group

ex.en: A few months later they return to their breeding grounds in the Arctic.
ex.zh: 幾個月後，牠們會回到北極的繁殖地。

ex.en: He breeds horses on his farm.
ex.zh: 他在農場養馬。

breed.en: to have young animals, or to keep animals to produce young

ex.en: Filth breeds illnesses.
ex.zh: 髒亂會滋生疾病。

ex.en: Clear water breeds no fish.
ex.zh: 水至清則無魚。

breed.en: to cause something bad to develop

ex.en: He thought of a brilliant idea.
ex.zh: 他想到了一個絕妙的點子。

ex.en: Suddenly she had a brilliant inspiration.
ex.zh: 她突然有了一個絕妙的靈感。

ex.en: She is a brilliant engineer.
ex.zh: 她是一位才華洋溢的工程師。

ex.en: The room was filled with brilliant sunshine.
ex.zh: 房間裡灑滿了燦爛的陽光。

ex.en: She wore a dress in brilliant red.
ex.zh: 她穿著一件鮮紅色的洋裝。

ex.en: Many young people in Japan eat bread for breakfast.
ex.zh: 很多日本年輕人早餐吃麵包。

ex.en: There is an oven to bake bread in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 廚房裡有烤箱可以烤麵包。

ex.en: Because Mary was hungry, she bought some bread.
ex.zh: 瑪麗餓了，所以買了一些麵包。

bread.en: a common food made from flour and baked

ex.en: We spoke briefly.
ex.zh: 我們簡短地聊了一下。

ex.en: She glanced briefly at the newspaper.
ex.zh: 她很快地瞄了一眼報紙。

ex.en: To put it briefly, I do not agree.
ex.zh: 簡單來說，我不同意。

briefly.en: for a short time or in few words

ex.en: She said that she brushes her teeth every morning.
ex.zh: 她說她每天早上都會刷牙。

ex.en: Last night, I went to bed without brushing my teeth.
ex.zh: 昨晚我沒刷牙就去睡了。

ex.en: Jack brushed the dust off his coat.
ex.zh: 傑克把外套上的灰塵刷掉。

brush.en: to clean or move something using a tool with stiff hairs

ex.en: I've bought a new palette and a few paint brushes.
ex.zh: 我買了一個新的調色盤和幾支畫筆。

ex.en: Use a soft brush to clean the screen.
ex.zh: 用軟毛刷清潔螢幕。

brush.en: a tool with stiff hairs used for cleaning, painting or tidying hair

ex.en: I would like to brush up my English.
ex.zh: 我想加強一下我的英文。

ex.en: I need to brush up on my French before the trip.
ex.zh: 出發前我得複習一下法文。

brush.en: to improve a skill you have not used for some time

broadcasting.zh: 廣播業、廣播電視（節目的播送）

ex.en: She has worked in broadcasting for ten years.
ex.zh: 她在廣播電視業工作了十年。

ex.en: The company is a leader in digital broadcasting.
ex.zh: 這家公司是數位廣播的領導者。

broadcasting.en: the work of sending out radio and television programs

ex.en: A light breeze stirred the surface of the lake.
ex.zh: 一陣微風吹皺了湖面。

ex.en: The leaves quivered in the breeze.
ex.zh: 樹葉在微風中顫動。

ex.en: A breeze stirred the leaves.
ex.zh: 一陣微風吹動了樹葉。

ex.en: The exam was a breeze for her.
ex.zh: 這次考試對她來說輕而易舉。

ex.en: With the new software, filing reports is a breeze.
ex.zh: 有了新軟體，提交報告變得很輕鬆。

ex.en: She breezed through the job interview.
ex.zh: 她輕鬆通過了工作面試。

ex.en: Tom breezed into the meeting ten minutes late.
ex.zh: Tom 遲到十分鐘，卻若無其事地走進會議。

breeze.en: to do something or move in an easy, confident way

ex.en: The murmur of the brook lulls me to sleep.
ex.zh: 小溪潺潺的流水聲伴我入眠。

ex.en: We followed a small brook into the forest.
ex.zh: 我們沿著一條小溪走進森林。

ex.en: The manager will brook no delay.
ex.zh: 經理不容許任何延誤。

ex.en: She brooks no argument on this point.
ex.zh: 在這一點上，她不容許任何爭辯。

browse.zh: 隨便看看、瀏覽（商品、網頁）

ex.en: I'm just browsing.
ex.zh: 我只是隨便看看。

ex.en: I spent an hour browsing in the bookstore.
ex.zh: 我在書店裡逛了一個小時。

browse.en: to look at things in a shop or on the internet without a plan

ex.en: I don't mean to brag.
ex.zh: 我不想吹牛。

ex.en: He bragged about the killing.
ex.zh: 他吹噓這場謀殺。

ex.zh: 他喜歡吹噓自己賺了多少錢。

brag.en: to talk too proudly about what you have done or own

ex.en: Breathing has become difficult.
ex.zh: 呼吸變得困難了。

ex.en: I have trouble breathing.
ex.zh: 我呼吸困難。

ex.en: Tom has breathing problems.
ex.zh: 湯姆有呼吸方面的問題。

breathing.en: the act of taking air in and out of the body

ex.en: People protested against police brutality in the capital.
ex.zh: 民眾在首都抗議警察暴力。

ex.en: The film shows the brutality of war without glorifying it.
ex.zh: 這部電影呈現了戰爭的殘酷，卻沒有美化它。

ex.en: His death was broadcast all over the world.
ex.zh: 他過世的消息傳遍了全世界。

ex.en: We broadcast news on the hour.
ex.zh: 我們每個整點播報新聞。

ex.en: That program is now being broadcast.
ex.zh: 那個節目現在正在播出。

broadcast.en: to send out a program on radio or television

ex.en: We watched a live broadcast of the concert.
ex.zh: 我們看了演唱會的現場直播。

ex.en: The news broadcast starts at seven.
ex.zh: 新聞節目七點開始。

broadcast.en: a program on radio or television

ex.en: Which brand of toilet paper do you usually buy?
ex.zh: 你通常買哪個牌子的衛生紙？

ex.en: I want a reliable brand that has good reviews.
ex.zh: 我想要評價好、可靠的品牌。

ex.en: The bags from this brand are too expensive.
ex.zh: 這個牌子的包包太貴了。

brand.en: a name and design that a company uses for its products

ex.en: I bought a set of brand new speakers.
ex.zh: 我買了一套新的音響。

ex.en: The brand new pen is easy to use.
ex.zh: 這支全新的筆很好寫。

brand.en: completely new and not yet used

ex.en: The campaign helped increase brand awareness.
ex.zh: 這次活動幫助提升了品牌知名度。

ex.en: Social media is a cheap way to build brand awareness.
ex.zh: 社群媒體是建立品牌知名度的便宜方法。

brand awareness.en: how well people know and recognize a company's name and products

ex.en: Before the site visit, the engineer gave reporters a briefing on the safety plan.
ex.zh: 實地參訪前，工程師向記者簡要說明安全計畫。

ex.en: The sales team attended a morning briefing on the new pricing rules.
ex.zh: 業務團隊早上參加了新定價規則的說明會。

briefing.en: a short meeting where people are given information

ex.en: The hotel serves brunch from ten until two on Sundays.
ex.zh: 飯店每週日十點到兩點供應早午餐。

ex.en: They invited the new neighbors to brunch.
ex.zh: 他們邀請新鄰居一起吃早午餐。

brunch.en: a meal eaten late in the morning that replaces breakfast and lunch

ex.en: Could you send me a brochure?
ex.zh: 可以寄一份簡介手冊給我嗎？

ex.en: I picked up a few brochures at the visitor center.
ex.zh: 我在遊客中心拿了幾份簡介手冊。

brochure.en: a thin book or paper with pictures and information about a product

breathtaking.zh: 美得令人屏息的、驚人的

ex.en: Thousands of workers and artisans toiled for 22 years to create this breathtaking white marble structure.
ex.zh: 數千名工人和工匠辛勤工作了 22 年，才打造出這座令人驚歎的白色大理石建築。

ex.en: The view from the top was breathtaking.
ex.zh: 從山頂看出去的景色美得令人屏息。

breathtaking.en: so beautiful or amazing that you are surprised

ex.en: My leg was broken in a traffic accident.
ex.zh: 我在一場交通意外中折斷了腿。

ex.en: He got a broken jaw and lost some teeth.
ex.zh: 他下巴骨折，還掉了幾顆牙。

broken.en: having a crack or split, as a bone does

ex.en: Would you please replace the broken one promptly?
ex.zh: 可以請你儘快把壞掉的那個換掉嗎？

ex.en: There was a broken cup on the table.
ex.zh: 桌上有個破杯子。

broken.en: damaged and no longer working or whole

ex.en: Using the data without permission is a breach of contract.
ex.zh: 未經許可使用資料是違約行為。

ex.en: He was fired for a serious breach of company rules.
ex.zh: 他因嚴重違反公司規定而被開除。

breach.en: an act of not obeying a rule or agreement

ex.en: More than 28 million Canadians were affected by privacy breaches last year.
ex.zh: 去年有超過 2,800 萬名加拿大人受到隱私外洩的影響。

ex.en: The bank reported a data breach last month.
ex.zh: 這家銀行上個月通報了資料外洩事件。

breach.en: a failure in security that lets private information get out

ex.en: Let's brainstorm some ideas for the new campaign.
ex.zh: 我們來為新的宣傳活動腦力激盪一下。

ex.en: The team brainstormed for an hour before choosing a name.
ex.zh: 團隊腦力激盪了一個小時才選定名稱。

brainstorm.en: to think of many ideas quickly, often with a group

ex.en: The farm is famous for the breeding of horses.
ex.zh: 這座農場以養馬繁殖聞名。

ex.en: Breeding season for the birds begins in spring.
ex.zh: 鳥類的繁殖季節從春天開始。

ex.en: Her good breeding showed in the way she spoke to everyone.
ex.zh: 她和每個人說話的方式都顯示出良好的教養。

ex.en: He was a man of fine breeding and polite manners.
ex.zh: 他是個有教養、舉止有禮的人。

ex.en: The statue is made of bronze.
ex.zh: 這座雕像是青銅做的。

ex.en: She won a bronze in the swimming contest.
ex.zh: 她在游泳比賽中拿到銅牌。

ex.en: He wore a bronze medal around his neck.
ex.zh: 他脖子上掛著一面銅牌。

ex.en: The sunset gave the lake a bronze color.
ex.zh: 夕陽讓湖面呈現古銅色。

ex.en: The doorknob is made of polished brass.
ex.zh: 門把是用拋光的黃銅做的。

ex.en: Brass turns green when it gets old.
ex.zh: 黃銅變舊後會變成綠色。

ex.zh: 樂團的銅管樂器組演奏得很大聲。

ex.en: Trumpets and trombones are brass instruments.
ex.zh: 小號和長號是銅管樂器。

ex.en: The brigade moved to a new base last month.
ex.zh: 這個旅上個月移防到新的基地。

ex.en: A brigade is usually larger than a battalion.
ex.zh: 旅通常比營還要大。

ex.en: The fire brigade arrived within five minutes.
ex.zh: 消防隊在五分鐘內就趕到了。

ex.zh: 志工們在慶典結束後組成了清潔隊。

ex.zh: 新娘由父親陪著走過紅毯。

ex.en: Everyone said the bride looked beautiful in white.
ex.zh: 大家都說穿白紗的新娘很美。

ex.zh: 英國是位於歐洲西北部的島國。

ex.zh: 他們去年夏天搭火車遊遍了英國。

ex.zh: 茶是英國很受歡迎的飲料。

ex.zh: 她持有英國護照。

ex.zh: 我週末喜歡看英國的喜劇節目。

ex.en: The British are known for drinking a lot of tea.
ex.zh: 英國人以愛喝茶聞名。

ex.zh: 許多英國人住在倫敦這類大城市。

ex.zh: 布萊恩是許多父母會幫兒子取的名字。

ex.en: Brian called me this morning to ask about the schedule.
ex.zh: 布萊恩今天早上打電話來問行程表。

ex.zh: 布里斯托是英格蘭西部的一座港口城市。

ex.zh: 我們從倫敦搭火車去布里斯托。

ex.zh: 布魯斯是英語系國家常見的男孩名字。

ex.zh: 布魯斯這個名字在蘇格蘭也是常見的姓氏。

ex.zh: 巴西是南美洲最大的國家。

ex.zh: 巴西人說葡萄牙語。

ex.zh: 布魯塞爾是比利時的首都。

ex.zh: 我們搭火車從巴黎到布魯塞爾。

ex.zh: 布賴頓是英格蘭南岸的海濱城市。

ex.en: We spent a sunny weekend in Brighton.
ex.zh: 我們在布賴頓度過了一個晴朗的週末。

ex.zh: 布拉德福德是英格蘭北部的一座大城市。

ex.zh: 布拉德福德過去以毛紡織業聞名。

ex.zh: 他挑起一邊眉毛，驚訝地看著我。

ex.zh: 她讀著字條時皺起了眉頭。

ex.zh: 他用毛巾擦掉額頭上的汗。

ex.zh: 她思考時，額頭上出現一道深深的紋路。

ex.zh: 我生病時，媽媽會煮溫暖的雞湯給我喝。

ex.zh: 把麵條放進湯裡煮三分鐘。

ex.zh: 我們參觀了啤酒廠，還品嚐了新鮮的啤酒。

ex.zh: 河邊那間舊啤酒廠已被改成餐廳。

ex.zh: 他晚餐後倒了一小杯白蘭地。

ex.zh: 這個蛋糕用泡過白蘭地的葡萄乾製成。

ex.zh: 百老匯是紐約一條以劇院聞名的街道。

ex.zh: 我們在轉角的咖啡館喝了一杯巴西咖啡。

ex.zh: 巴西隊踢的足球節奏很快。

ex.zh: 我的室友是個熱愛音樂的巴西人。

ex.en: Many Brazilians speak Portuguese.
ex.zh: 許多巴西人說葡萄牙語。

ex.zh: 陽光明亮地照在湖面上。

ex.en: The children were brightly dressed for the parade.
ex.zh: 孩子們為了遊行穿得色彩鮮豔。

ex.zh: 這座城鎮正在為一場強颱做準備。

ex.zh: 她得戴兩年牙套。

ex.zh: 我弟弟去年夏天裝了牙套。

ex.zh: 他們用木梁支撐那面老牆。

ex.zh: 他雙腳抵住地板用力推。

ex.zh: 一位英國選手在比賽中奪得金牌。

ex.en: Many Britons enjoy a cup of tea in the afternoon.
ex.zh: 許多英國人喜歡在下午喝杯茶。

ex.zh: 布賴恩是常見的男孩名字。

ex.zh: 布賴恩今年秋天正在為馬拉松做訓練。

ex.zh: 她左手腕戴著一只銀手鐲。

ex.en: He gave his sister a bracelet for her birthday.
ex.zh: 他送姊姊一條手鍊當生日禮物。

ex.zh: 這張桌子寬兩公尺。

ex.en: We measured the length and breadth of the room.
ex.zh: 我們量了房間的長和寬。

ex.zh: 我佩服她知識的廣博。

ex.zh: 這門課涵蓋的主題非常廣泛。

ex.en: She bought a comfortable sports bra for running.
ex.zh: 她買了一件跑步用的舒適運動內衣。

ex.en: This shop sells bras in many sizes.
ex.zh: 這家店販售各種尺寸的胸罩。

ex.zh: 她跌倒後膝蓋上有一大塊瘀青。

ex.zh: 那塊瘀青一夜之間變成了紫色。

ex.zh: 蘋果掉到地上很容易碰傷。

ex.zh: 我的手臂撞到門而瘀青了。

ex.zh: 那句苛刻的評語傷了她的自尊。

ex.zh: 那間公司瀕臨倒閉。

ex.en: She stood at the brink of the cliff and looked down.
ex.zh: 她站在懸崖邊緣往下看。

ex.zh: 分手之後她難過了好幾個禮拜。

ex.en: The singer wrote a song about her breakup.
ex.zh: 那位歌手寫了一首關於她分手的歌。

ex.zh: 那家老公司解體後分出了三家新公司。

ex.en: The breakup of the ice allowed ships to pass.
ex.zh: 冰層碎裂讓船隻得以通行。

ex.zh: 天剛亮之後，天空開始變亮。

ex.zh: 幾盞燈就能讓這個陰暗的角落亮起來。

ex.zh: 她的笑容讓大家的早晨都開朗了起來。

ex.zh: 聽到好消息時，他的臉上露出了喜色。

ex.zh: 我媽媽幾乎每天晚上都會蒸綠花椰菜當晚餐。

ex.zh: 很多小孩不喜歡綠花椰菜的味道。

ex.en: Please lower the brightness of your screen at night.
ex.zh: 晚上請把螢幕的亮度調低。

ex.zh: 星星的明亮讓孩子們驚嘆不已。

ex.zh: 主播平靜地播報晚間新聞。

ex.en: The national broadcaster will show the game live.
ex.zh: 國家電視台將直播這場比賽。

ex.zh: 釀酒師品嚐了啤酒，確認它的味道。

ex.zh: 一位當地的釀酒師在我們鎮上開了間小店。

ex.zh: 這位年輕鋼琴家在音樂會上演奏得非常出色。

ex.en: Our team solved the problem brilliantly.
ex.zh: 我們團隊把這個問題解決得很漂亮。

ex.en: The sun shone brilliantly over the lake.
ex.zh: 陽光燦爛地照耀著湖面。

ex.en: The fireworks lit up the sky brilliantly.
ex.zh: 煙火燦爛地照亮了夜空。

ex.zh: 我們繞著湖快步走了一圈。

ex.zh: 他快步出發趕火車。

ex.zh: 一陣清爽的風吹過田野。

ex.en: It was a brisk autumn morning.
ex.zh: 那是個涼爽清新的秋天早晨。

ex.en: The ice cream shop did brisk business in July.
ex.zh: 七月時，這家冰淇淋店生意興隆。

ex.en: Sales were brisk during the holiday weekend.
ex.zh: 假日週末的銷售十分熱絡。

ex.en: The old plastic became brittle and cracked easily.
ex.zh: 那塊舊塑膠變得很脆，一下就裂開了。

ex.zh: 骨質脆弱的人，輕輕跌一跤就可能骨折。

ex.zh: 她吃了一塊酥脆的花生糖。

ex.zh: 她跑上樓梯後氣喘吁吁地到了。

ex.zh: 群眾屏息靜候結果。

ex.zh: 釀啤酒需要耐心和乾淨的器具。

ex.zh: 這個村莊以釀酒傳統聞名。

ex.zh: 她正在為客人沖泡一壺茶。

ex.zh: 咖啡沖煮的香味把我叫醒了。

ex.zh: 看那些烏雲，暴風雨正在醞釀。

ex.zh: 兩個部門之間正醞釀著麻煩。

ex.zh: 這條街的兩旁排列著老舊的褐砂石建築。

ex.en: The store does not pay for breakage during shipping.
ex.zh: 商店不負責運送途中的破損。

ex.en: Pack the glasses carefully to avoid breakage.
ex.zh: 把杯子仔細包好，以免破損。

bro.zh: 老兄；兄弟（朋友間的稱呼）

ex.en: Hey bro, want to grab lunch together?
ex.zh: 嘿，老兄，要不要一起去吃午餐？

ex.en: Thanks for helping me move, bro.
ex.zh: 謝謝你幫我搬家，兄弟。

ex.en: Some groups try to brainwash young people online.
ex.zh: 有些團體試圖在網路上對年輕人洗腦。

ex.en: Don't let advertisements brainwash you into buying things.
ex.zh: 別讓廣告洗腦你去亂買東西。

ex.en: The film describes the brainwash methods used by a cult.
ex.zh: 這部電影描述了一個邪教所用的洗腦手法。

ex.en: He said the lecture felt like a brainwash session.
ex.zh: 他說那場演講感覺像一場洗腦。

brezhnev.zh: 布里茲涅夫（蘇聯領導人）

ex.en: Leonid Brezhnev led the Soviet Union for many years.
ex.zh: 布里茲涅夫領導蘇聯多年。

ex.en: The history book has a chapter on the Brezhnev era.
ex.zh: 那本歷史書有一章談布里茲涅夫時期。

ex.en: Brahms was a German composer who lived in the nineteenth century.
ex.zh: 布拉姆斯是十九世紀的德國作曲家。

ex.en: The orchestra will play a symphony by Brahms tonight.
ex.zh: 管絃樂團今晚將演奏布拉姆斯的一首交響曲。

ex.en: The newspaper published a broadside against the new tax plan.
ex.zh: 報紙刊出了一篇猛烈抨擊新稅制計畫的文章。

ex.en: The coach unleashed a broadside at the referee after the game.
ex.zh: 賽後教練對裁判發出了猛烈的批評。

ex.en: He ran up the stairs and spoke breathlessly.
ex.zh: 他跑上樓梯，氣喘吁吁地說話。

ex.en: The children waited breathlessly for the show to begin.
ex.zh: 孩子們屏息等待表演開始。

brutus.zh: 布魯特斯（古羅馬政治家）

ex.en: Brutus was a Roman senator who took part in the plot against Julius Caesar.
ex.zh: 布魯特斯是羅馬元老院議員，參與了對凱撒的陰謀。

ex.en: Shakespeare wrote a play about Julius Caesar in which Brutus is a major character.
ex.zh: 莎士比亞寫過一齣關於凱撒的戲，布魯特斯是其中的主要角色。

brainchild.zh: 個人獨創的構想、心血結晶

ex.en: The new app is the brainchild of two students.
ex.zh: 這個新應用程式是兩位學生的心血結晶。

ex.en: The festival was her brainchild.
ex.zh: 這個慶典是她一手想出來的點子。

ex.en: The speech was praised for its brevity.
ex.zh: 那場演講因簡短扼要而受到稱讚。

ex.en: Brevity is important when you write a text message.
ex.zh: 寫簡訊時，簡潔很重要。

ex.en: For the sake of brevity, I will skip the details.
ex.zh: 為了簡短起見，我就省略細節。

ex.en: A breakaway group left the party to form a new one.
ex.zh: 一個分裂出去的團體離開了政黨，另組新黨。

ex.en: The breakaway region wants to run its own affairs.
ex.zh: 那個脫離出去的地區想要自行處理事務。

ex.en: The cyclist made a breakaway and led the race.
ex.zh: 那位自行車選手突圍而出，領先整場比賽。

ex.en: The striker's breakaway led to a goal.
ex.zh: 前鋒的快速突破帶來了一次得分。

ex.en: Let's take a breather before we climb the next hill.
ex.zh: 爬下一座山丘前，我們先休息一下吧。

ex.en: After the long meeting, she stepped outside for a breather.
ex.zh: 開完冗長的會議，她走到外面喘口氣。

ex.en: He gave me some brotherly advice about my career.
ex.zh: 他給了我一些兄長般的職涯建議。

ex.en: The two friends shared a brotherly bond.
ex.zh: 這兩位朋友之間有著如兄弟般的情誼。

ex.en: He became the family's breadwinner after his father retired.
ex.zh: 父親退休後，他成了家裡的經濟支柱。

ex.en: She is the main breadwinner in her household.
ex.zh: 她是家中主要負擔家計的人。

ex.en: Years of war can brutalize ordinary people.
ex.zh: 多年戰爭可能使一般人變得冷酷殘忍。

ex.en: The film shows how prison can brutalize young men.
ex.zh: 這部電影呈現監獄如何使年輕人變得殘暴。

ex.en: The queen wore a gown of gold brocade.
ex.zh: 女王穿著金色錦緞的禮服。

ex.en: The sofa was covered in rich red brocade.
ex.zh: 沙發覆蓋著華麗的紅色織錦。

ex.en: This breathable fabric keeps you cool while running.
ex.zh: 這種透氣的布料讓你跑步時保持涼爽。

ex.en: Choose breathable shoes for the summer.
ex.zh: 夏天要選透氣的鞋子。

ex.en: The air on that planet is not breathable.
ex.zh: 那顆行星上的空氣無法呼吸。

ex.en: Fire fighters checked whether the air was breathable.
ex.zh: 消防員檢查空氣是否適合呼吸。

ex.en: The restaurant is famous for its slow-cooked beef brisket.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳以慢火燉煮的牛胸肉聞名。

ex.en: We served sliced brisket with potatoes at dinner.
ex.zh: 我們晚餐端出切片的牛胸肉配馬鈴薯。

ex.en: We had braised beef with carrots for dinner.
ex.zh: 我們晚餐吃了紅蘿蔔燉牛肉。

ex.en: The braised pork was tender and full of flavor.
ex.zh: 這道燉豬肉又嫩又入味。

ex.en: The waiter gave a brusque reply and walked away.
ex.zh: 服務生簡慢地回了一句就走開了。

ex.en: Her brusque manner made her seem unfriendly at first.
ex.zh: 她唐突的態度讓她一開始顯得不太友善。

ex.en: Bremen is a port city in northern Germany.
ex.zh: 不來梅是德國北部的一座港口城市。

ex.en: The Town Musicians of Bremen is a famous fairy tale.
ex.zh: 《不來梅的城市樂手》是一則著名的童話。

ex.en: She covered the fish with a layer of breadcrumb before frying it.
ex.zh: 她在炸魚之前先裹上一層麵包屑。

ex.en: There was a single breadcrumb left on the plate.
ex.zh: 盤子上只剩下一小片麵包屑。

ex.en: The little bird picked up every breadcrumb we dropped.
ex.zh: 小鳥把我們掉的每一粒麵包屑都啄走了。

ex.en: The truck sped down the hill at breakneck speed.
ex.zh: 卡車以不要命的高速衝下山坡。

ex.en: The city is growing at a breakneck pace.
ex.zh: 這座城市正以驚人的速度擴張。

ex.en: Brecon is a small town in Wales.
ex.zh: 布雷肯是威爾斯的一個小鎮。

ex.en: Many hikers stay in Brecon before climbing in the nearby hills.
ex.zh: 許多健行者在布雷肯過夜，再去爬附近的山丘。

ex.en: She prefers branded clothes to unknown labels.
ex.zh: 比起沒沒無聞的牌子，她比較喜歡名牌衣服。

ex.en: The store sells branded sneakers at a discount.
ex.zh: 這家店以折扣價販售名牌運動鞋。

branded.zh: 被貼上標籤；被烙印（brand 的過去式）

ex.en: The media branded him a troublemaker.
ex.zh: 媒體給他貼上了麻煩製造者的標籤。

ex.en: The farmers branded each cow with a number.
ex.zh: 農夫在每頭牛身上烙上一個編號。

ex.en: The bricklayer built a neat wall around the garden.
ex.zh: 砌磚工人在花園周圍砌了一道整齊的牆。

ex.en: My uncle worked as a bricklayer for thirty years.
ex.zh: 我叔叔當了三十年的砌磚工人。

browsing.zh: 瀏覽；隨意翻看（browse 的現在分詞）

ex.en: I spent the afternoon browsing in a small bookstore.
ex.zh: 我整個下午都在一間小書店裡隨意翻看。

ex.en: She is browsing the internet for cheap flights.
ex.zh: 她正在網路上瀏覽便宜的機票。

ex.en: Our team spent an hour brainstorming new ideas.
ex.zh: 我們團隊花了一小時腦力激盪想新點子。

ex.en: Brainstorming works best when nobody judges the ideas.
ex.zh: 腦力激盪在沒人批評點子時效果最好。

ex.en: The old paper had turned brownish with age.
ex.zh: 那張舊紙隨著年代變成了褐黃色。

ex.en: She has brownish hair and green eyes.
ex.zh: 她有一頭微棕的頭髮和綠色的眼睛。
